name: Gallery Feed for TikTok
author: websynctech

sections.description:
Gallery Feed for TikTok is the easiest way to embed TikTok videos, profiles, and feeds directly into your WordPress site.

Showcase your TikTok content in beautiful layouts while displaying real engagement metrics such as likes, views, comments, shares, video duration, and user avatars. Whether you’re a blogger, influencer, brand, or agency, this plugin helps you turn visitors into engaged followers and boost your SEO with fresh, dynamic video content.

✨ Key Features (Free)

  • Embed TikTok videos & feeds anywhere using shortcode or Gutenberg block.
  • Layouts included: Thumbnail Grid and Blog Style.
  • Rich video data: Display titles, descriptions, likes, views, comments, shares, duration, and profile avatar.
  • Unlimited feeds: Add multiple TikTok accounts on the same page.
  • Responsive design: Works perfectly on desktop, tablet, and mobile.
  • Auto updates: Feeds refresh automatically.
  • Optimized & cached: Fast loading and SEO-friendly.

🚀 Pro Features

  • Masonry Layout: Pinterest-style dynamic grid.
  • Slideshow / Carousel Layout: Showcase TikTok videos in a slider.
  • Advanced customization: Control colors, spacing, number of videos, and more.

🎯 Why Use Gallery Feed for TikTok?

  • Keep users on your site longer with interactive TikTok content.
  • Improve SEO with fresh, user-generated video content.
  • Showcase social proof with real-time engagement metrics.
  • Easily integrate multiple TikTok feeds with zero coding.

Privacy Policy

This plugin uses the official TikTok API to fetch video data (titles, thumbnails, likes, comments, views, shares, duration).

  • No personal account data is stored.
  • Data is retrieved only for display purposes.
  • Feeds update automatically at set intervals.

References:
– TikTok Terms of Service
– TikTok Privacy Policy
– Our Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for Gallery Feed for TikTok.
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  4. Go to TikTok Feed → Add New Feed to connect your TikTok account.
  5. Choose your layout (Grid, Blog, Masonry, or Slideshow).
  6. Copy the shortcode and paste it into any post, page, or widget.
  7. Or use the dedicated TikTok Feed block in the block editor.
sections.faq:
How do I connect my TikTok account?

Go to TikTok Feed → Add New Feed and follow the simple authentication process with the official TikTok API.

Can I display videos from any TikTok account?

Yes, you can show videos from your own profile or any public TikTok account.

Is there a limit to how many feeds I can create?

No, you can create unlimited TikTok feeds and display them across your site.

Which layouts are free and which require Pro?

Free version includes Thumbnail Grid and Blog Style layouts.
Pro unlocks Masonry and Slideshow/Carousel layouts with advanced styling.

Will this plugin slow down my site?

No. It is lightweight, uses caching, and is built for performance.
